correctness.rationale: The affine change (a,b) to normalized (D0,D1) is bijective for u nonzero and q odd. The third normalized discriminant is 2y-x+2. Expanding the weighted nonsquare indicators gives a triple quadratic-character sum q, and exact weighted inclusion–exclusion of the three zero lines contributes 3q-3. Therefore 8N=(q-1)(q-3). Universal field-independent character-sum identities are proved/explicitly cited. A standalone small-field exhaustive calculation of 2322 step cases corroborates all assumptions and small boundary fields.

originality.rationale: Theorem 1.1 of arXiv:1206.3930 implies only N=q^2/8+O(q^{3/2}) when specialized; it cannot imply the exact q-dependent lower-order correction, coefficient uniformity as an identity, or sharp q=3 obstruction. A 2015 consecutive-polynomial study is about degree-increasing coefficient prefixes, while 2009 Bender–Pollack concerns asymptotic pairs. Accessible previous scientific claims include cubic irreducibility pairs and quartic squarefreeness pairs but no irreducible quadratic triple. A 2002 plausible chapter lacks inspected full text and is specifically identified as residual risk.
